title: Arkret Moderation Report Operation
description: Closed signed-request DTO for ak.self.moderation.command.report.v1. Canonical evidence and franking-proof objects live in moderation-evidence.schema.json so Event payload validation does not depend back on an operation request schema.

moderation_report_event_submission.description: Direct-holder signed ak.self.moderation.report DataEvent. The self endpoint accepts only absent/self provenance and forbids delegated executor, Applet and MIMI-facade provenance. event.actor_id and payload.reporter MUST equal the authenticated session principal. event.realm_id, payload.realm_id, the signed scope_ref and the accepted target's derived governance scope MUST match exactly. A Realm-default report may omit payload.effective_scope; a Circle report MUST sign the exact Circle scope. The target MUST be accepted and visible to the reporter; absent, invisible and scope-mismatched targets all return the same not_found response. This DataEvent carries seal_ref and auth_context and MUST NOT carry seal_basis or preconditions. The service forwards exact signed bytes through ordinary Event admission and never authors, rebuilds, co-signs or adds guards.

moderation_report_request_body.description: Carries exactly one direct-holder signed moderation report Event and no unsigned report projection.
